request: Implement compatible(min_schema,max_schema,deployed) in src/release_gate.py with inclusive bounds. Wire src/cli.py run(payload) to combine compatibility with existing tests_passed. Return {"release": tests_passed AND compatibility,"compatibility":boolean}. Document remediation: migrate schema or deploy compatible application. Documentation must contain these literal phrases: ["migrate schema", "compatible application"]. Preserve all public interfaces stated here. Python entrypoint is src.cli.run(payload). Inputs are JSON objects; return only plain JSON-compatible values (no Decimal objects, sets or tuples). Use only the standard library. Visible test tools check syntax only; functional verification is external.
title: Require migration compatibility in release checks
